annotations.text: Final · Convexa v1 (2026-10-14). The whole app in its ruled state, one row per screen: the spec card (purpose, every widget’s data source, production vs staging, every state in its words, phone, acceptance, build status, rulings, code), then staging (the demo account: signed in, all sample), production where it differs (no mocks; what needs the Massive options feed shows Not live), phone, light and states. Carries P-1–P-4, P-6, P-8–P-15 and the 2026-10-14 environment rulings. The earlier pages stay as history.
Planned · designed, not built — the public-data tools from docs/public-data/CANDIDATES.md

Ticker desk — the tweak chips switch readState (idle · loading · trade · no_trade · stale · cooldown · signed_out · no_key), live (pulses, particles, trail), scheme (dark · light) and the phone sheet (open · peek). Click “Analyze current snapshot” to run loading → trade; Field / Magnet switches the hero. Expand this frame and resize your window: the layout is fluid.

Same source, five widths. Every frame here renders the identical page body through one set of media and container queries — nothing is redrawn by hand. The phone desk docks the AI read as a bottom sheet; tables become cards under 1000px; the settings rail becomes tabs under 900px.

Site surfaces at 1440. Copy is grounded in the product (69-name universe, ~60s desk cadence, ~3-min scanner sweep, 7–45 DTE, simulated book, BYO key); all prices, P/L, scores and timestamps are sample values.

Every overlay and gate in the product: sign-in and the private-testing wall, the one shared sim trade-entry dialog in both variants (with the six binding disclosures verbatim), the egress drawer, persona editing, order detail in both coverage states, the scan view editor, route fallback, 404, and the two operator surfaces.

v4 · Data states (2026-10-13). The hybrid site: live where free public data reaches, honestly not live where the paid options feed is needed. Source map → state matrix → the NVDA desk in both honest options (explain, or a labelled sample). Every board names the review findings it resolves (design/REVIEW-2026-10-13.md). Figures are illustrative design values.

v4 · Tools from public data (2026-10-13). Source of truth: docs/public-data/CANDIDATES.md and its status words (live · switch · build · verify · blocked). Top row: the roadmap and the built research pages, re-sourced and joined by the new tools. Rows below: one sheet per priority tool with desktop, phone and every state. Blocked tools draw their design target with illustrative values; the gate is open question Q-1.

v4 · App (2026-10-13). One row per route: desktop 1440 dark, phone 390, light 1440, then the route’s states board. The ticker desk’s desktop and phone boards are on v4 · Data states. Findings per route: design/REVIEW-2026-10-13.md (wave 3). Figures are illustrative design values.

v4 · Research refresh (2026-10-13). The note view with neutral directions supersedes the research canvas’s Main board (that canvas is left as it is); the index with its tabs; phone boards for Markets, Filings, Scorecard and ticker research; light boards for every research page and the state matrix; Markets in the demo build.

v5 · Charts (2026-10-13). Wave 1 audits every chart in the app and on these boards (design/CHARTS-2026-10-13.md); wave 2 is one chart system: a frame that makes a claim and names its source, a plot with text at true size, labels on the data, a table twin, one tab stop, the seven data states. Values are illustrative; sources are the ones the app reads.
The library is generated from tokens/tokens.json and src/components — every state shown there is a registered state. The light renders prove the scheme is a token swap, not a second layout.
